 US official tells Al Jazeera a missile launch site on Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz was attacked in response to Iran’s earlier attack on US base in Bahrain.
 US Central Command said multiple drones launched by Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps towards a US radar system at the Bahrain airbase “were intercepted without any damage to US equipment or personnel”.
